approvalHelpManual: You decide when an action requires approval.
approvalHelpAutomatic: Tool approvals are accepted automatically without expanding the agent’s permissions. Enabling this mode requires confirmation.
sandboxHelpreadOnly: The agent can read files without changing sources.
sandboxHelpworkspaceWrite: The agent can write only to locations authorized by the project.
sandboxHelpdangerFullAccess: Disables sandbox restrictions. This option is blocked for managed agent copies.
mcpInternalNotObservedHint: No internal connection has been observed for this agent. It is configured when sending a message; this status alone does not indicate a failure.
managedAgentIsolationHint: The agent can switch between read-only and writing in its authorized workspace. Full access remains blocked to protect other agents’ workspaces.
alwaysAllowConfirmation: From the next message, MCP tool approvals will be accepted automatically for this agent, for all its users. Actions can modify or delete data accessible to these tools. Project permissions, workspace isolation and published-document protection remain enforced. Questions and sign-ins requiring your input will not be answered automatically.
approvalModesHint: On request: you decide. Never allow: actions requiring approval are refused. Always allow: tool approvals are accepted automatically, without expanding the agent’s permissions.
managedCliOfficialBlocked: Official updates and unvalidated rollbacks are blocked to preserve sandbox protections and the compatibility fix.
managedCliManagerUnavailable: The Manager does not provide a validated CLI. Update the compatible Manager first; no official CLI will be installed as a fallback.
managedCliAvailable: Validated release provided by the Manager
managedCliConfirm: Install {{release}} from the Manager bundle, verify its integrity, then restart Codex only when agents are idle. The previous selection will be restored if activation fails.
projectAgentTestProfileLabel: Test profile for new project agents
projectAgentTestProfileDescription: Global default for new project work agents: writable workspace and filtered command networking, only when the engine confirms enforced administrator network rules. Explicit permission choices and read-only locations are preserved. Does not change existing conversations, grant Docker access or publish Git changes.
agentTestProfileHint: Applies from the next message. Keeps the current writable folders, Git and document protections. Allows only managed network destinations and local test targets. No Docker access or sandbox bypass; Chromium must still pass the preflight.
agentTestProfileUnavailable: Unavailable until the running engine confirms enforced administrator network rules. Proxy environment variables alone are not sufficient. Select workspace-write first.
commonInstructionsScope: Sent to all work agents, new and existing, at every new turn. Saved persistently without restarting Codex. A turn already in progress is not changed.
commonInstructionsSafety: Administrator setting for this instance: do not include secrets. Does not change AGENTS.md files, project instructions or permissions. Instructions guide an agent but cannot technically guarantee execution.
commonInstructionsHelp: {{count}} / {{max}} characters. Empty text disables these instructions. Restoring the default prepares a draft: save to apply it.
commonInstructionsSaveError: Could not save. Your draft is preserved; please retry.
commonInstructionsSaved: Instructions saved. They will apply to each agent’s next turn.
dictationBackendIndependent: Audio and chat engines are independent. Until an audio choice is saved, dictation follows the chat engine.
dictationCliWarning: Experimental: uses the Codex voice session over WebRTC without an API key. Availability depends on the browser, CLI version and account voice access. Errors never switch to the API-key engine.
reasoningEffortDescription: Controls the effort spent solving the task. Higher effort may require more time and tokens; available levels depend on the model.
reasoningSummaryDescription: Controls the detail of the summary provided in the thinking blocks. This is not raw internal reasoning, and a more detailed summary does not increase reasoning effort.
responseVerbosityDescription: Controls how concise or detailed the agent’s response text is. Does not hide commands, results or logs; their display is controlled by each agent’s Technical details setting.
